record.oneLiner: Meta Ads Marketing API enables programmatic creation, management, and optimization of ad campaigns across Meta technologies using Graph API endpoints.
record.verdictReason: Meta Ads provides a comprehensive Marketing API that can be accessed self-serve by creating a developer app and generating User or System User access tokens. Initial access is granted automatically, with production limits scaling up after usage.

evidence.quote: Every Marketing API call requires an access token as a parameter.
Automatically granted when you add the Marketing API product to your app.
The Marketing API is a collection of Graph API endpoints and other features that can be used to help you advertise across Meta technologies.
This repository is a collection of reference implementations for the Model Context Protocol (MCP), as well as references to community-built servers and additional resources.
